NRI Property Management

Property management built around an owner who lives abroad: remote communication, documented inspections and someone accountable in Chennai.

Discuss Your Property WhatsApp Us

The problem this solves

Managing a flat in Chennai from the US, the Gulf, the UK, Singapore or Australia means time-zone gaps, relying on relatives who have their own lives, and never quite knowing what state the property is in. Every decision takes a week of messages.

What the service includes

  • Everything in Complete Property Management, set up for remote decision-making
  • Communication windows that fit your time zone where practical
  • Reports designed to be read on a phone: photographs first, then the notes
  • Approval requests with enough detail to decide without a call
  • Coordination with a person you nominate in India for key access or signatures
  • Support during your visits to Chennai: pre-arrival readiness and a walk-through together

How it works

Remote onboarding

A video call to understand the property and your expectations, then an onboarding visit with a full report.

Plan

Scope, fee, approvals and reporting cadence in writing. Approval thresholds are tuned to how involved you want to be.

Ongoing

Inspections, tenant matters and maintenance run as planned, with updates on WhatsApp and email.

When you visit

We prepare the property and meet you there if you want to walk through it together.

What you receive

  • Onboarding report
  • Inspection reports and maintenance records on your phone
  • A single contact who knows your property's history
  • Organised records you can share with a buyer, tenant or accountant

Limits and exclusions

  • We do not give tax advice on NRI rental income, repatriation or FEMA matters; we can share records with your chartered accountant.
  • Power of attorney, if ever needed for a specific transaction, is a legal arrangement between you and a lawyer, not something we hold by default.

Questions about this service

What time zones do you work with?

Most owners are in the US, the Gulf, the UK, Singapore and Australia. Updates are sent so they are waiting when you wake up; calls are scheduled to overlap with our business hours (9 AM–7 PM IST).

Do I need to give you power of attorney?

No. Day-to-day management does not require it. If a transaction ever does, that is arranged through your lawyer.

Can my parents or a relative in Chennai still be involved?

Yes. Many owners keep a relative as a nominated contact for keys or signatures while we handle the work and reporting.

No questions match that. Ask us directly on WhatsApp or through the contact page.
